name: skonasani/Chicago-Permits-Analysis
what_it_holds: Pipeline (SQL + Python via Socrata API) over the City of Chicago's public building-permits dataset, 236,847 records, with a dashboard on neighborhood-level permit-driven demand signals.
why_useful: Building-permit volume is a direct new-housing-supply proxy relevant to STR-host-supply growth in a major ABNB market (Chicago is in the team's 13-city Inside Airbnb panel); the Socrata ingestion code is reusable for other cities' open permit portals too.
size_hint: 236,847-row Chicago permits dataset (pulled live via Socrata, not necessarily committed as a static file)
time_coverage: per Chicago Data Portal permits dataset (2006-present typically)
themes: Housing supply and investor activity: building permits, Redfin investor purchases, mortgage rates, county assessor/parcel data, LLC ownership, NYC PLUTO/ACRIS
why_all: Building-permit volume is a direct new-housing-supply proxy relevant to STR-host-supply growth in a major ABNB market (Chicago is in the team's 13-city Inside Airbnb panel); the Socrata ingestion code is reusable for other cities' open permit portals too.
